sections.heading: What is trending: “probleme microsoft”
paragraphs: “probleme microsoft” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for RO (snapshot taken 2026-11-13T07:57:19+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Adevărul, Agerpres, Observator News. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “O întrerupere la nivel global afectează serviciul de e-mail Outlook al Microsoft” — Agerpres
“Pană globală la Microsoft: Outlook, Teams și Copilot, afectate. Remedierea nu decurge conform așteptărilor” — Observator News
“Pană majoră la Microsoft. Probleme raportate joi seara și de utilizatorii din România” — Adevărul

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 12 Nov 2026 23:10:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-13T07:57:19+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-13T07:57:39+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
